plan.description: Load and preprocess the single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy. This step involves reading the h5ad file, performing basic quality control, normalization, and filtering to prepare the dataset for downstream analysis.
input_filename: /cs/student/projects2/aisd/2024/shekchu/projects/cell_agents/remove_label/dataset_restricted_with_labels.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq breast cancer dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes, gene names, and malignancy classifications.
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/preprocessed_data.h5ad: Preprocessed single-cell AnnData object with quality controlled and normalized data

plan.description: Extract malignant cells from the preprocessed dataset. Based on the provided malignancy annotations in the dataset, filter the cells to only include those labeled as 'malignant'.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/preprocessed_data.h5ad: Preprocessed single-cell AnnData object with quality controlled and normalized data
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object containing only malignant cells extracted from the dataset

plan.description: Compute cell cycle scores for the malignant cells using Scanpy's built-in functionalities. This step uses known marker gene lists for cell cycle phases to score each cell, which will later inform the classification into quiescent, proliferative, or slow-cycling states.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object containing only malignant cells
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/malignant_cells_with_scores.h5ad: AnnData object of malignant cells with added cell cycle scores

plan.description: Classify malignant cells into 'quiescent', 'proliferative' or 'slow-cycling' based on the computed cell cycle scores. Establish thresholds (or use clustering approaches within Scanpy) to assign each malignant cell to one of the three categories. Finally, export the classification results as a CSV file containing the cell barcodes and their corresponding cell cycle state.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/malignant_cells_with_scores.h5ad: AnnData object of malignant cells with computed cell cycle scores
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_malignancy2/cell_cycle_classification.csv: CSV file reporting cell barcodes and classification as quiescent, proliferative, or slow-cycling
